packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts:72 - getBaseConditions can return a top-level OR without outer parentheses.. When there are no filters, `getBaseConditions()` returns the auth condition as is. For org and team scope that is `(A) AND (B) OR (C) AND (D)`, with no outer parentheses. The same happens with a lone eventTypeId filter, which yields `("eventTypeId" = x) OR ("eventParentId" = x)`. Callers are expected to embed the value in a larger WHERE clause. If one writes `WHERE ${base} AND "createdAt" >= ${start}`, AND binds tighter than OR, so the extra predicate applies only to the last OR branch. The query then returns rows outside the date range, status filter or similar. I could not see the callers to confirm one composes this way. Fix: wrap every returned fragment, e.g. return `Prisma.sql\`(${authConditions})\`` and wrap the reduced OR/AND results, so the value is always safe to embed.

packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts:29 - The looser constructor type drops compile-time checking of options.. The constructor now takes `InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions` (where `teamId` is optional) instead of the discriminated union. So `{ scope: "team" }` without a `teamId` now type-checks. At runtime the zod parse then fails, and the service quietly returns `1=0`, meaning no data, instead of the mistake being caught at compile time. Consider keeping `InsightsBookingServiceOptions` as the parameter type.
